name: Park Jae-hyun
bio:
Park Jae-hyun's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for taking apart and rebuilding electronics. This curiosity led him to pursue mechanical engineering, where he quickly excelled. After graduating, he joined a local engineering firm, but his passion for speed led him to motorsport. He started in a junior formula team, working his way up the ranks through dedication and a keen eye for detail.

As a chief engineer, Park is known for his pragmatic approach to problem-solving. He prefers data-driven decisions over gut feelings, and he is a firm believer in meticulous planning and preparation. His ability to see the 'big picture' allows him to anticipate potential issues and implement proactive solutions, making him a valuable asset to any racing team. Park is a firm believer in continuous improvement, always seeking new ways to optimize performance.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with slight recession at the temples.
physical.description: A man of medium build with a focused gaze, Park exudes an air of quiet confidence.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, even on race day.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on drinking only green tea during race weekends.
